_: The utility apps the shell (public/app/shell.js) draws; index.html is its Home (N18). Shape: docs/DESIGN-NOTES-2026-10.md Part 2.4. state built = route is a utility page; workshop = it exists only inside the workshop, so no route and a dashed chip (FIT Q3, I12); coming = not built. facts = an /api URL the shell GETs, answering { lines: [ 'text' | { text, tone:'dn' } ] } (at most two lines); null = no such read exists yet, so the card shows no figure (never an invented one) — the reads each card needs are listed in the N18 PR. rail = the Home widget: facts answers { suppliers, customers, in, out, stuck } (digits); route = where Open goes; null = not drawn. Every facts URL needs its line in the API's round-trips.budget.json (I19). No 'tier' (Q5). OPTIONAL per entry, read by the index roadmap (never by the shell): rows = plan ids from MASTER-BUILD-2026-10.md (e.g. M30, R06; [] or absent = no row yet) · phase = its phase in that plan, as one short string (e.g. P3 books + payments) · fits = one short line on how it connects to the rail. The roadmap and the fit diagram on index.html are drawn from these rows only; state decides every chip.
